authorship_disclosure: Reviewer authored policy serialization, benchmark policy helpers and their focused tests. Independent source review covers the separately authored owner/driver/collector/benchmark/agent/control integrations and tests. Source custody checks do not imply independent authorship of the helpers.

findings.detail: Literal owner argv is duplicate-checked and parsed as strict bounded policy JSON. The factory rejects conflicting explicit/serialized policy or profile mismatch before sealed-prompt reads. Generated launch removes separate and equals forms of the owner-only flag from the worker command while retaining original handoff argv for owner broker admission.

Driver validates enabled/full policy selection before instruction/state IO and retains recipe/binding digests. Census, nonsemantic and provider-free candidate source-view routes refuse. The supported model-router path forwards one canonical recipe argument.

Selected recipe requires exact full arm, matching canonical recipe/current implementation digests, and actual shared descriptor policy binding. Historical absent-policy sessions retain existing behavior. Partial digest fields, recipe/schema/profile tampering and selected-policy downgrade to a legacy descriptor refuse; source/discovery/candidate wire-byte accounting is retained.

Preparation detaches recipe/config observations. Execute/collect compare recipe, both digests, config hash and retained comparison controls. Simultaneous policy removal and rewritten config hash is checked against original controls on reachable policy-observation paths; existing outer task/provider guards may refuse first.

Agent detaches input and pins canonical observation containing recipe and current resolver/codec binding. Setup/run recheck profile, recipe and binding before environment actions. CLI file input is bounded UTF-8 and preparation-only, and forwarding uses one literal canonical JSON argument.

The initial attempt remains fail after 182 executed cases and 11 failures. Exactly three new test files changed: removable comment moved after first code, the same sealed stdin routed to both generated owner factories, and expected early task/provider refusal behavior asserted rather than requiring a policy-specific receipt. Frozen product bytes and original logs/JUnit/14 source snapshots are unchanged.

Collection can raise an existing task-binding or provider-profile ValueError before producing a policy observation/receipt for edited config. The corrected tests require the exact early refusal and no receipt for those paths; reachable policy mismatches retain unchangedFalse/incomplete observations. No guard is weakened to manufacture an observation.

The finite-proof-query isolated guard requires the exact signed native candidate argv plus UID prefix. Stripping owner-only policy JSON changes that command, so the combination is refused. The benchmark semantic-model dispatcher does not add finite-proof-query flags. No signed owner-to-worker argv transformation is implemented or qualified.

Syntactic recipes grant no path admission. Existing owner source/population/currentness/lifecycle/byte-budget checks still apply. Resolver/helper changes alter policy bindings and archive capability pins; old identities require regeneration/rebuild while checkpoint and embedding assets remain unchanged.

limitations: Read-only static source/snapshot and historical evidence verification; no qualification-02 pass prediction or test result assessment.
Finite-proof-query plus shared policy is unsupported and fails the existing exact-command guard.

The collector alone cannot distinguish removal of all benchmark policy fields from historical shared sessions. Retained preparation/control and agent freeze checks supply the supported benchmark downgrade boundary, without cryptographic authentication of arbitrary rewritten historical artifacts.
Owner admission can refuse a syntactically valid recipe whose protected paths are missing, foreign or unsupported in the bounded admitted task population.

Authored generated-owner, broker and environment seams do not establish new cross-UID Docker behavior, live-model compact editing, semantic proof, official reward, complete import closure or complete-session token savings.
